entry.content:
September 16, 2026 6:18 PM
I think I might be onto something!
September 7, 2026 8:45 PM
Spent sometime trying to troubleshoot why the coaches keep derailing. Looks like I do need something weighing atleast 100gms to stabilize these coaches on the rails. That and also better couplers maybe?
🔗

September 6, 2026 3:18 PM

The Paper mache mountain that I built yesterday afternoon collapsed last night. Ouch. The base was just not strong enough, soaked in all the wet glue and and collapsed under it’s own wait. An avalanche of ginormous proportions! Lesson learnt - need a better skeleton. 🔗

What started off as a model rail project is now going quite beyond that. The more I think about it, the more I’d like to expand the diorama. This is going to take time and I’m in no rush! 🔗

September 4, 2026 9:42 PM
Scanned all my students’ notes from 2011. Long pending admin task that I finally got done today. Used all those papers and started building some paper mache landscape for the rail diorama.
August 23, 2026 11:04 AM

It’s here! This is an absolute piece of beauty and I can already imagine how this could be a wicked good hobby! So many ideas on how I want to stage this! 🔗

Spent about and hour or so laying out the rail lines and testing the WAP5. SO freaking love this! Wish S could be a bit more involved in this. Issue however is, the model is so tiny and needs a good deal of patience…. 🔗

🔗

June 21, 2026 9:30 AM
Finally went ahead and ordered a couple model engines and a full train set from ThePinkEngine. They did flag that they were struggling to keep up with the orders. Will be beyond psyched if I can lay my hands on these sometime over the next month!
🔗

entry.title: Digital Photoframe
entry.summary: December 5, 2025 4:22 PM Tom’s post nudged me to revive my Digital photo frame that I set up last year. Turned it on this morning and it lit up like it was setup a minute ago. Love it! Took me a minute though to figure out how I’d initially set it up since I missed documenting it then. So here’s a quick note for posterity… Arzopa! December 1, 2025 3:18 PM Generated / updated the Arzopa tags for my photos in Digikam and refreshed the Digital frame. Need to document this setup better for my future-self. May 23, 2024 5:45 PM Used the spare RPI3 I salvaged from the NCP migration and made a decent digital photo frame. Ever since I consolidated all my photos, I’ve been wanting to setup a digital frame that would take us back in time on command. Some version of ‘On this day’ – but for photos. I think I have a solution that is close to what I had in mind. The photos are currently on a USB drive synced from my Nextcloud server via a cron job. I still need to work out how I choose what photos get displayed when. But so far, I am pretty happy with how this has turned out.

I think I have a solution that is close to what I had in mind. The photos are currently on a USB drive synced from my Nextcloud server via a cron job. I still need to work out how I choose what photos get displayed when. But so far, I am pretty happy with how this has turned out.
